answer: Distance-gated juries: a grader's quill is only handed to identities at least three hops from the author in the funding-and-attestation graph, so a clone ring can never grade itself. To pass, a 1,000-key farm must first age 1,000 unlinked keys past the 26-epoch intake ledge, each passing on its own merit, then still face strangers who zero onyx-polished reskins: roughly 26,000 original answers to earn about 3 POA per key.
